summary: Fixes the GitHub sign-in callback so the welcome email (Resend) is sent to newly created users; adds an unused @tailwindcss/line-clamp dev dependency.

misses.what: New users signing in with GitHub for the first time now receive a 'Thanks for using ChadNext!' welcome email (never sent before).
The email send is not awaited (fire-and-forget), so on serverless hosting it may be dropped silently.
